Medical AI and Biomedical Imaging: surgical and healthcare AI

topics.name: Agent Safety, Reliability, and Evaluation
topics.summary: These investigations test whether agent behavior remains safe, grounded, and accountable under failures, adversarial inputs, uncertain rewards, or changing protocols. Trace diagnostics and calibrated risk measures matter more than one aggregate score.

topics.name: Visual Recognition and Dense Prediction
topics.summary: Perception papers learn detection, segmentation, classification, or anomaly representations under weak labels, domain shift, occlusion, and ambiguous boundaries. Multiscale features and uncertainty-aware objectives make visual decisions more reliable.

topics.name: Other Machine Learning Methods
topics.summary: These papers develop focused learning procedures or application-specific analyses that do not share enough structure with larger clusters. Their experiments or proofs still contribute reusable ideas about representation or model behavior.

topics.name: Efficient Inference and Model Compression
topics.summary: The collection reduces memory, latency, energy, or communication through quantization, pruning, distillation, caching, routing, and compact architectures. Results focus on deployment tradeoffs hidden by nominal accuracy.

topics.name: Social, Behavioral, and Human-Centered AI
topics.summary: The work studies people’s behavior, preferences, communication, and interaction with AI, including persuasion, education, workplace use, and social simulation.

topics.name: Autonomous Driving, UAVs, and Traffic Safety
topics.summary: Vehicle and aerial-robot papers fuse perception, prediction, planning, and safety constraints for roads, airspace, or cooperative missions. Simulation and hardware-oriented tests expose how distribution shift changes collision risk.

topics.name: Statistical Modeling and Signal Processing
topics.summary: The collection develops statistical estimators, signal representations, and probabilistic models for structured data where assumptions and finite-sample behavior matter.

topics.name: Graphs, Networks, and Relational Learning
topics.summary: Graph-based methods represent interactions, topology, or structured dependencies with message passing, spectral operators, and iterative inference. The papers examine temporal change, heterophily, influence, and communication limits.

topics.name: Time-Series Forecasting and Dynamical Models
topics.summary: Temporal modeling papers forecast evolving signals, detect regime changes, or estimate latent dynamics under missing data and nonstationarity. Adaptive context and physical structure replace assumptions of a fixed seasonal process.

topics.name: Attention, Optimization, and Training-Dynamics Diagnostics
topics.summary: These analyses probe efficiency and interpretability tradeoffs, regime-level predictability, dense inconsistency in language-model risk estimates, and the memory carried by Adam moments.

topics.name: Information Retrieval, Recommendation, and Ranking
topics.summary: These systems retrieve, match, rank, and recommend items or documents by combining dense and sparse representations, user intent, and sequential feedback.

topics.name: Long-Horizon Agent Planning and Control
topics.summary: Long-horizon control combines latent world models, plan-aware representations, solver or game feedback, bounded plan reduction, and state verification. Results across GUI, embodied, and predictive settings indicate that intermediate progress signals help agents sustain coherent action over many steps.

topics.name: Generative image, video, audio, and 3D modeling
topics.summary: Diffusion, flow, autoregressive, and structured generative methods for images, video, audio, motion, scenes, avatars, and virtual try-on.

topics.name: 3D reconstruction and geometric scene modeling
topics.summary: Geometric models combine Gaussian primitives, scene graphs, spherical or stereo cameras, canonical object frames, occupancy tracking, and feed-forward rendering. The applications include indoor panoramas, urban simulation, avatars, articulated objects, digital twins, LiDAR mapping, and long-range outdoor SLAM.

topics.name: Quantum machine learning and circuit synthesis
topics.summary: Quantum query benchmarks, spectral data reuploading, transformer-based molecular-state preparation, and quantum-walk algorithms encode problem structure into circuits; frequency or Hamiltonian information reduces search and improves preparation efficiency.

topics.name: LLM alignment and preference learning
topics.summary: Alignment papers study preference optimization, reward modeling, and refusal behavior across language and multimodal agents, using comparisons, critiques, and safety tests to balance capability with reliability.

topics.name: Hybrid Physical Structure and Simulation Models
topics.summary: Stratified contact modes, uncertainty-bounded strain sensing, and smooth surrogates expose discrete structure inside physical planning, measurement, and dynamical-system optimization.

topics.name: Robot manipulation and morphology-aware learning
topics.summary: Robotic systems learn compliant control, grasping, tactile policies, whole-body retargeting, contact-rich skills, and morphology transfer. Experiments span soft arms, quadrupeds, additive manufacturing, endovascular tools, and real-to-sim settings, with closed-loop feedback used to improve execution.

topics.name: LLM Agents and Agentic Systems
topics.summary: These papers connect llm agents and agentic systems with language, but, and framework; their abstracts examine evaluation and llms under measurable data or deployment constraints.

topics.name: Agent memory and personalization
topics.summary: Agent-memory studies organize personal context, episodic traces, and preference signals for adaptive assistance; experiments show that selective retention and personalized retrieval can improve usefulness while limiting irrelevant or sensitive history.

topics.name: LLM Evaluation, Benchmarks, and Reliability
topics.summary: The work builds tests, simulators, or evaluation protocols that expose capability gaps, brittle reasoning, calibration failures, and reliability problems in language-model systems.

topics.name: Optimization and statistical learning theory
topics.summary: These papers study kernels, bandits, smoothing, constraints, and training theory using formal analyses and controlled numerical experiments; analyses find that rates, regret, and failure modes guide practical algorithm design.

topics.name: Robotic manipulation and dexterous control
topics.summary: Robotics papers learn contact, force, handover, teleoperation, surgical actions, soft actuators, and dexterous skills from vision, tactile signals, or world models. Active perception and predictive monitoring improve control under changing dynamics.

topics.name: Human activity recognition and privacy-aware sensing
topics.summary: Activity recognition systems address environmental, client, and privacy variation using WiFi, inertial, skeleton, and CCTV signals. Temporal consistency, selective transfer, relational distillation, and federated personalization improve recognition of falls and other safety-relevant behavior.

topics.name: Process rewards and reinforcement for reasoning
topics.summary: Structured rewards, recursive latent computation, self-correction, and risk-sensitive objectives improve intermediate reasoning without simply increasing answer length.

topics.name: Medical Imaging and Clinical AI
topics.summary: Clinical pipelines combine denoising, PET synthesis, mammography and polyp analysis, radiology reports, pathology field selection, ultrasound uncertainty, segmentation, and counterfactual explanations. Across modalities and datasets, calibration, label-efficient sampling, and clinically meaningful evidence are recurring requirements for transfer.

topics.name: Closed-loop planning for robots and autonomous vehicles
topics.summary: Embodied agents convert observations and language into actions through behavior-aware manipulation, aerial verification, adaptive computation time, unified perception-action models, and plant-checked outputs. Autonomous-driving planners add selective semantic reasoning and declarative trajectory constraints for traceable real-time decisions.

topics.name: Interpretability and Explainable AI
topics.summary: Causal tracing, feature attribution, Shapley-style explanations, operator-facing interfaces, and probes of learned representations are applied to UAV security, biology, remote sensing, medical imaging, and language models. Across settings, useful explanations require testing causal influence, stability, and audience fit.

topics.name: Privacy-Preserving Machine Learning
topics.summary: These papers connect privacy-preserving machine learning with privacy, utility, and ecg; their abstracts examine federated and under under measurable data or deployment constraints.

topics.name: Language-model safety and alignment
topics.summary: Language-model safety work studies privacy-preserving retrieval, watermark provenance, model routing, medical vision systems, and challenge benchmarks, balancing protection, traceability, and retained task capability.

topics.name: Interactive Web and Coding Agents
topics.summary: GUI transition models, pre- and post-action evidence checks, repository maps, lexical retrieval, embeddings, and uncertainty-aware file search improve interactive and code-generation workflows. The studies show that state-aware context selection enables more localized recovery and repair.

topics.name: Social Media Manipulation and Computational Social Science
topics.summary: Longitudinal platform data, agent-based simulations, survey-grounded personas, and network diffusion experiments study bots, misinformation, incentives, self-censorship, and competing narratives. Findings connect individual perceptions and platform dynamics to broader influence outcomes.

topics.name: LLM alignment and post-training
topics.summary: Post-training methods combine preference optimization, adaptive data selection, multi-teacher distillation, online imitation, reward decomposition, and intermediate representations. Across language, multimodal generation, dialogue, and molecular applications, they seek better capability transfer while limiting reward distortion and instability.

topics.name: Knowledge-grounded reasoning and retrieval
topics.summary: Counterfactual tests, graph retrieval, reflection, beam search, and ordered contexts reveal brittle reasoning chains and poor allocation of test-time computation.

topics.name: Benchmarks, Audits, and Measurement Reliability
topics.summary: Benchmark and audit papers design tasks, datasets, rubrics, and protocols for capabilities or risks that headline scores compress. Their contribution is exposing leakage, disagreement, item regressions, or unreliable stopping rules.

topics.name: Retrieval-augmented generation and long-term memory
topics.summary: These papers pair retrieval or structured memory with language-model workflows, showing that evidence selection, provenance checks, and persistent context shape grounded answers and long-horizon behavior.

topics.name: Molecular, Materials, and Biological Machine Learning
topics.summary: The group applies foundation models, graph networks, agents, spectral prediction, generative modeling, and benchmark analysis to proteins, molecules, materials, plant physiology, mass spectrometry, and manufacturing.

topics.name: Geometric optimization and registration
topics.summary: Geometric optimization supplies smooth trajectories, registrations, tensor decompositions, obstacle avoidance, and parameterized models. Across mathematical analyses and clinical or robotic measurements, the recurring goal is preserving structure while controlling curvature, conditioning, nonsmoothness, and alignment error.

topics.name: Energy, Power, and Industrial Systems
topics.summary: These studies forecast, control, or secure physical infrastructure such as power grids, batteries, buildings, and industrial processes using data-driven models.

topics.name: Remote sensing segmentation and visual sensing
topics.summary: Overhead and field imagery is processed with click propagation, active sampling, frequency cues, foundation-model features, and change captioning. Applications include crop surveys, solar defects, disaster mapping, rip currents, and environmental monitoring, with emphasis on sparse labels and fine structures.

topics.name: Physics-informed scientific machine learning
topics.summary: Equation residuals, constitutive structure, spectral representations, and learned surrogates support simulation or inference for fluids, orbital systems, particle data, polymers, nanopore signals, and materials. Gains include stability, label efficiency, uncertainty handling, and better physical extrapolation.

topics.name: Auditing LLM Knowledge, Affect, and Social Behavior
topics.summary: Temporal knowledge, summary sentiment, human-label ceilings, psychometric structure, sycophancy, refusal asymmetry, and metaphor explanation reveal unstable or measurement-dependent model behavior.

topics.name: Policy Learning with Feedback, Memory, and Execution Delay
topics.summary: Task abstractions, search-policy mixing, imperfect human correction, process rewards, coordinated action heads, delay compensation, and reactive replanning improve policies beyond fixed open-loop execution.

topics.name: Structured Data, Operations, and Applied Prediction
topics.summary: Applied learning handles tabular records, spreadsheets, business processes, logistics, and operational demand with structured encoders or constrained optimization. Realistic missingness and capacity limits shape the decisions.

topics.name: Natural language processing methods
topics.summary: Natural-language studies build ITSM and rural-clinical pipelines, simulate mental-health interactions, generate theorem-prover scripts, and harden agent defenses, showing how language models move into operational domains.

topics.name: Parallel Decoding and KV-Cache Compression
topics.summary: The shared goal is faster long-context generation through multi-unit prediction, deferred recurrent state, granular paging, eviction recovery, and selective visual-text retention.

topics.name: AI Security, Privacy, and Governance
topics.summary: The studies audit deployed models through calibration, membership and inversion probes, vulnerability graphs, and lifecycle risk controls. They connect sensitive-information exposure and operational failure to concrete routing, reporting, and assurance practices.

topics.name: Learned Compression and Efficient Vision
topics.summary: Entropy-model experts, multiscale latents, packet-loss resilience, FPGA co-design, and I/O-aware convolutions reduce storage or execution cost for images, point clouds, SAR data, and neural networks. Results show that input-aware allocation and graceful degradation improve practical deployment.

topics.name: Reconfigurable Tendon and Wire-Driven Robots
topics.summary: Both mechanisms alter robot geometry through remotely routed actuation, emphasizing detachable or rotating structures that expand reach without dedicating a motor to every joint.

topics.name: NLP, document intelligence, and multilingual learning
topics.summary: Language research spans translation, multilingual adaptation, document-to-database construction, rhetoric, code and prose generation, and semantic analysis, using curated corpora and structured evaluation to expose cross-lingual and contextual gaps.

topics.name: Evidence-Grounded Hallucination Detection
topics.summary: Citation verification, question-conditioned temporal localization, span-level source alignment, and null-token cues tie generated answers to observable video, text, or acoustic evidence.

topics.name: Multi-Agent Coordination, Identity, and Delegation Security
topics.summary: Agent societies are studied through interaction topology, evolving identity, formal decision authority, bounded delegation, and negotiation under partial radio knowledge.

topics.name: Multimodal Language and Vision-Language Reasoning
topics.summary: These systems align text with images, video, audio, or spatial evidence so multimodal models can answer questions, ground claims, and follow visual instructions.

topics.name: Networked Stochastic Learning and Message Passing
topics.summary: The papers characterize how information aggregates under communication, memory, geometry, and Markov dependence, deriving finite-sample or convergence behavior for decentralized learners.

topics.name: Prototype, Multi-View, and Binding Representations
topics.summary: Sparse prototypes, correlated incomplete views, operation-level transfer, and dual-encoder limits clarify which relational structure survives compression into shared latent spaces.

topics.name: Robust Network Traffic and Graph Anomaly Detection
topics.summary: Traffic classifiers and temporal-graph detectors are stress-tested against drift, encryption, leakage, and weak baselines, with emphasis on labels and evaluation protocols that survive deployment shifts.

topics.name: Causal Inference and Policy Learning
topics.summary: The papers address domain-shifted fragility, hidden confounding, strategic behavior, counterfactual recourse, causal abstraction, policy learning, and treatment or incentive timing from observational data.

topics.name: Decentralized Multi-Robot Task and Coverage Allocation
topics.summary: Auction consensus and predictive radio negotiation coordinate distributed robot choices when communication, geometry, and each action's effect on team-level coverage are only partially observable.

topics.name: Financial Policy Learning and Combinatorial Arbitrage
topics.summary: Adversarial imitation, auxiliary-task discovery, and compact QUBO encodings learn or optimize trading decisions under market dynamics and hard currency-cycle constraints.

topics.name: Physiological and Clinical State Prediction
topics.summary: Electronic records, RGB-radio fusion, and tissue graphs support pain grading, remote heart-rate estimation, and cardiac property inference while accounting for fairness or heterogeneous signals.

topics.name: Responsible Population and Environmental Modeling
topics.summary: Groundwater governance, harmonized migration records, and constraint-aware synthetic populations foreground provenance, feasibility, and responsible use in policy-facing computational models.

topics.name: Retinal and Ophthalmic Representation Learning
topics.summary: Stereo shape phenotypes, OCT-to-OCTA reconstruction utility, and ordinal low-resolution grading connect ocular structure with population analysis and disease assessment.

topics.name: Road Perception and Mobility Forecasting
topics.summary: Selective driving memory, geometry-matched pavement detection, and inverse-reinforcement path prediction connect visual road evidence with robust long-horizon motion forecasting.

topics.name: Contextual Argumentation and Common Ground
topics.summary: Both frameworks make conflict resolution sensitive to context, representing changing value priorities or feasible agreement regions rather than treating arguments as globally fixed.

topics.name: Generative AI as a Socioeconomic Model and Market Actor
topics.summary: Voting reconstruction and corpus-erosion theory treat language systems as models of collective behavior and as economic intermediaries whose extraction changes the information supply.

topics.name: Model Serving and 3D Rendering Acceleration
topics.summary: Global operator scheduling and roofline-guided splat optimization coordinate kernels around hardware bottlenecks to raise throughput under concurrent inference or rendering workloads.

topics.name: Sports Tracking and Corruption-Robust Action Recognition
topics.summary: Training-free association and byte-level corrupted-video modeling target reliable sports analytics when identities evolve over long sequences or pixel decoding itself becomes unavailable.

topics.name: Uncertainty Quantification and Calibration
topics.summary: Post-hoc calibration, evidential models, selective prediction, ensemble confidence, and goodness-of-fit tests recur across language, medical, genomic, and tabular settings. The papers show that confidence is useful only when matched to distribution shift, coverage, and error structure.

topics.name: Speech and Audio Modeling
topics.summary: Speech and audio studies cover expressive prosody, atypical and child speech, clinical language signals, enhancement, generation, and instrument or affect recognition. They use speaker-aware evaluation, graph or prototype representations, simulation, and adaptive sampling to expose domain and low-resource limitations.

topics.name: Cybersecurity and Networked Systems
topics.summary: The papers analyze attacks, traffic, vulnerabilities, and defenses in networked or software systems, often pairing learned detectors with provenance-aware evaluation.

topics.name: Games and interactive agents
topics.summary: These papers study interactive play, game benchmarks, and generative game design using simulated environments and player-centered studies; analyses find that exploration, social interaction, and controllable generation work together.

topics.name: Urban and Cross-View Geospatial Perception
topics.summary: Geospatial methods combine semantic maps, geometric correction, reliability-weighted cross-modal features, environmental adaptation, route priors, and cartographic constraints. Urban localization, remote-sensing change detection, travel prediction, and map generalization all benefit from explicitly modeling viewpoint and sensing variation.

topics.name: Agentic applications and skill learning
topics.summary: Application-focused agents learn reusable skills, beliefs, context policies, and task-specific behaviors for scientific discovery, education, engineering, preference construction, and embodied systems. Distillation, self-generated credit, resource-aware search, and semantic interfaces support transfer across tasks and users.

topics.name: Segmentation and medical image analysis methods
topics.summary: These papers connect segmentation and medical image analysis methods with visual, search, and both; their abstracts examine quality and training under measurable data or deployment constraints.

topics.name: Audio generation and spatial audio
topics.summary: These works study real-time music and speech generation, spatial reproduction, historical instrument digitization, and multichannel coding. Streaming distillation, perceptual testing, acoustic measurement, and cross-modal prediction recur as ways to preserve timing and listening quality.

topics.name: Agent Orchestration, Memory, and Workflow Management
topics.summary: Agent infrastructure is organized around routed tools, scoped knowledge surfaces, reusable skills, workflow roles, and actively managed memory. Experiments with enterprise tasks, debate, prompt compression, and long-running systems show that selective retrieval and lifecycle control reduce overhead and improve traceability.

topics.name: Interpretability and representation analysis
topics.summary: Interpretability papers probe hidden features, causal mechanisms, and representation geometry with interventions or diagnostic benchmarks; findings connect measurable internal structure to transfer, bias, and model behavior.

topics.name: AI safety, privacy, and adversarial robustness
topics.summary: The papers address privacy accounting, poisoning, watermark forgery, harmful supervision, prompt injection, adversarial perception, malware, and secure IoT or semantic communication. Defenses combine formal analysis, representation changes, runtime monitoring, and deployment-specific risk measures.

topics.name: 3D reconstruction, Gaussian splatting, and neural rendering
topics.summary: These papers connect 3d reconstruction, gaussian splatting, and neural rendering with field, multi-view, and prototypes; their abstracts examine semantic and storage under measurable data or deployment constraints.

topics.name: 3D shape correspondence and point-cloud defects
topics.summary: Foundation-model-guided shape matching and synthetic geometric defects for correspondence and unsupervised point-cloud inspection.

topics.name: 3D vision, graphics, and geometric measurement
topics.summary: These systems estimate curved object dimensions or edit appearance using RGB-D geometry, neural UV parameterization, projection-aware synthesis, radiance-field transfer, and learned lighting. Evaluation emphasizes physical alignment, surface fidelity, and measurement accuracy.

topics.name: AI assurance and governance
topics.summary: Assurance frameworks combine runtime evidence, reproducibility checks, training-integrity controls, document and citation verification, and procurement or whistleblowing policies. Their common goal is an auditable basis for decisions about high-stakes AI.

topics.name: AI for disaster assessment and geospatial resilience
topics.summary: Learning and geospatial methods for disaster damage mapping, flood segmentation, infrastructure recovery, and repair prioritization.

topics.name: AI governance and deployment monitoring
topics.summary: Deployment governance specifies delegated authority, provenance, risk documentation, and monitoring signals, while behavioral diagnosis separates model capacity from roles, objectives, and institutional constraints. Failures should be attributed before selecting an intervention or drift response.

topics.name: AI governance, agentic evaluation, and social effects
topics.summary: These studies examine how AI systems should be evaluated and constrained in public use, from forecasting infrastructure and feedback aggregation to open-weight capability controls, international agreements, warning labels, visibility bias, user experience, and online participation.

topics.name: AI governance, evaluation, and scientific practice
topics.summary: Research integrity, AI governance, scientific peer review, paper-to-video assessment, construct validity, and evaluation beyond narrow benchmarks.

topics.name: AI in arts and creative practice
topics.summary: Style metrics, artist judgments, workshop interventions, interactive theater generation, and critical accounts of machine creativity examine both creative output and practitioner control. The evidence favors multidimensional evaluation and human-centered explanation over a single quality score.

topics.name: AI safety verification and generalization
topics.summary: Safety evaluations construct controlled failures, interactive checks, and distribution shifts to separate training success from deployment reliability. The studies examine conditional behavior mixtures and efficient proof protocols for verifying claims without relying solely on a competing model.

topics.name: AI safety, honesty, and rare-event assurance
topics.summary: Formal safety arguments, honest predictive behavior, and learned rare-event estimation for assessing unlikely failures.

topics.name: AI-ready data governance
topics.summary: Land registries, space-life-science repositories, and low-resource language corpora are examined through provenance, legal ownership, metadata, and license compatibility. Across settings, machine usability depends on durable validation and interoperable rights, not openness alone.

topics.name: Accessibility and Inclusive Technology
topics.summary: Automatic web accessibility assessment for color-vision deficiency and socio-technical analysis of cultural plurality in language technology.

topics.name: Accessibility and augmented reality collaboration
topics.summary: Assistive and collaborative interfaces combine multimodal agents, low-vision browsing, AAC design, situated AR, and occlusion-aware content placement. User studies and expert cases emphasize autonomy, workload, legibility, and preserving access to physical targets.

topics.name: Acoustic sensing and localization
topics.summary: Time-varying acoustic features estimate biological conditions and source position in noisy or changing environments. Applications include beehive monitoring and shape-changing microphone arrays on robots, with emphasis on temporal modulation and spatial reconstruction.

topics.name: Active learning for bioacoustic detection
topics.summary: Budgeted bioacoustic labeling is improved by selecting diverse and informative audio batches under severe class imbalance. Embedding-space coverage, soft disagreement weighting, greedy volume objectives, and facility-location criteria help discover rare calls with fewer annotations.

topics.name: Active sensing and target tracking
topics.summary: Motion planners and acoustic trackers handle sparse, uncertain observations while preserving coverage. Candidate-set updates, Bayesian filtering, and hydrophone measurements guide trajectory choice and multi-vehicle tracking.

topics.name: Advanced semiconductor packaging assurance
topics.summary: Advanced packaging research combines nanoscale mechanical security primitives with AI-guided nondestructive X-ray inspection. The papers link tamper resistance, experiment selection, and manufacturability for complex assemblies.

topics.name: Agent architectures, memory, skills, and workflows
topics.summary: Persistent skills, provenance, memory, stateful workflows, debugging, routing, and tool use for long-running language-model agents.

topics.name: Agent-based urban mobility simulation
topics.summary: Synthetic populations, semantic trajectories, route-choice models, social behavior, and network-scale pedestrian flows create configurable environments for testing mobility interventions. The methods connect high-level goals with physical movement and measurable crowd responses.

topics.name: Agentic AI Systems: agent memory and planning
topics.summary: These papers connect agentic ai systems: agent memory and planning with document, trie, and themes; their abstracts examine progressive and disclosure under measurable data or deployment constraints.

topics.name: Agentic Networks and IoT
topics.summary: Language-model agents for distributed IoT, cellular-network orchestration, V2X control, and decentralized prediction aggregation.

topics.name: Algorithmic auditing and reliability
topics.summary: Reliability audits use counterbalanced question orders, source-complete reconciliation, and account-level sampling to expose failures hidden by aggregate scores. Language-model judgments can shift with sequence or conflicting evidence, while platform visibility gaps may vanish after correcting confounding.

topics.name: Annotation-efficient and synthetic-data learning
topics.summary: Active selection combines uncertainty, coverage, stage dependencies, and temporal feasibility, while dataset condensation and digital-twin feedback generate useful training examples. The shared objective is preserving transfer and detection quality with fewer expert labels or target observations.

topics.name: Applied stochastic optimization for resource and portfolio decisions
topics.summary: Sequential decision methods use bounded lookahead, learned feasible decoders, and structured financial or energy models to accelerate planning under constraints. Applications include order fulfillment, portfolio allocation, commodity spreads, energy markets, and electric-bus scheduling, with attention to feasibility and value sharing.

topics.name: Artificial intelligence for art analysis and retrieval
topics.summary: Multimodal art systems model relations among visual features, text, and art-historical context rather than relying only on global similarity. Retrieval embeddings and expert-centered evaluation reveal gains in contextual matching alongside persistent calibration and ranking weaknesses in automated assessment.

topics.name: Astronomical and Spaceborne Sensing
topics.summary: The group develops compact learning and event-based sensing systems for exoplanet transit recovery, X-ray and optical catalog matching, and low-power orbital object detection.

topics.name: Audio Coding and Speech-Driven Media Understanding
topics.summary: Adaptive audio models respond to packet loss, sampling-rate changes, and media context at inference time. Evaluations connect codec efficiency with acoustic quality, while multimodal systems use voice, language, and visual cues for engagement and narrative attribution.

topics.name: Audio Grounding and Enhancement
topics.summary: Open-vocabulary audio event localization and causal spatial enhancement for moving speakers in ambisonic recordings.

topics.name: Audio perception and spoken interaction
topics.summary: Acoustic imaging, prototype-based open-set recognition, and probabilistic voice-activity modeling address unknown sounds and unnatural conversational timing. The methods emphasize covariance structure, rejection of unseen classes, and better turn-taking decisions from uncertain audio evidence.

topics.name: Auditable and equitable clinical screening
topics.summary: Screening studies examine explanation quality, calibration, synthetic-noise robustness, and subgroup-specific misses in child-trauma and chest X-ray settings. Their results show that operating thresholds and tail behavior can change clinical conclusions even when aggregate accuracy looks strong.

topics.name: Automated theory discovery in cognitive science
topics.summary: Agentic cognitive-science systems generate competing theories, fit them to simulated or crowdsourced behavior, design discriminating experiments, and refine successors. Their results recover known strategies while producing explanations that can outperform literature-based baselines.

topics.name: Autonomous sensing and information gathering
topics.summary: Planning systems select routes and sensors under limits on energy, coverage, geometry, and uncertainty. UAV monitoring and maritime scheduling demonstrate how adaptive information collection can outperform fixed observation policies.

topics.name: Battery health and lifetime prediction
topics.summary: Battery-management models jointly estimate health and remaining life from irregular or incomplete charge histories. Transformer encoders and degradation-aware multi-task objectives are assessed on established cell datasets, with uncertainty imbalance between targets treated as a central design issue.

topics.name: Biological sequence and cellular modeling
topics.summary: Single-cell representation learning, perturbation prediction, adipocyte development, protein generation, and therapeutic peptide design.

topics.name: Biomedical Representation and Biosignal Learning
topics.summary: Biomedical learning uses molecular, protein, dental, cryo-EM, single-cell, and physiological data with few-shot tabular models, spectral geometry, sparse alignment, and transferable channel embeddings. The studies emphasize useful structure when labels, connectivity, or sensor layouts are incomplete.

topics.name: Biomedical prediction and personalized health sensing
topics.summary: Personalized glucose forecasting, survival calibration, wearable vital signs, sleep staging, and physiological time-series modeling.

topics.name: Built-Environment Visual Reasoning and Search
topics.summary: Built-environment applications compare model and expert judgments for street-view typology, query semantic city models, and rerank conversational real-estate results. Performance benefits from domain context and human validation, especially when visual categories or user intent are ambiguous.

topics.name: Camouflaged and Low-Visibility Object Detection
topics.summary: Detection models address camouflage and difficult illumination using frequency-aware representations and paired RGB-thermal observations. Experiments target unreliable appearance cues across fog, darkness, terrain variation, and visually confusing backgrounds.

topics.name: Causal Heterogeneity in Health
topics.summary: Individualized causal effects connecting active mobility, urban environments, and mental-health outcomes.

topics.name: Clinical Speech and Caregiver Analytics
topics.summary: These studies use speech, transcripts, interaction data, and qualitative frameworks to assess cognitive impairment, Parkinsonian symptoms, dementia screening, caregiver needs, and clinician-centered evaluation.

topics.name: Clinical data curation and health knowledge systems
topics.summary: Clinical pipelines clean report-derived labels and organize multidisciplinary tumor-board evidence in graph-oriented systems. The recurring emphasis is traceable data preparation and structured decision support rather than isolated image prediction.

topics.name: Clinical ultrasound analysis
topics.summary: Prototype-based localization, anatomy-aware frame selection, and motion modeling support prenatal anomaly detection, fetal weight estimation, and cardiac phase recognition. These systems address operator variability and limited labels by exploiting temporal structure and reusable visual references.

topics.name: Cognitive architectures and open-ended agent evolution
topics.summary: These conceptual and empirical studies connect algebraic or developmental cognitive architectures with value learning and open-ended agent evolution. Comparisons of symbolic components, emotion-oriented designs, constraint selection, and fitness-free platforms ask how persistent structure and social values can emerge without opaque end-to-end training.

topics.name: Computational Cultural Heritage
topics.summary: Computational heritage work links archival records with graph structure, provenance, and geometry-constrained reconstruction. The resulting analyses use reproducible statistics to study transmission, design rules, and relationships among dispersed historical artifacts.

topics.name: Computational Financial Research
topics.summary: Financial research systems connect quote-grounded event extraction, memory-guided factor discovery, executable hypotheses, and empirical validation. The methods aim to make textual signals reproducible and to test whether extracted disclosures carry economically meaningful information.

topics.name: Computational Models of Texture and Symmetry
topics.summary: Texture and mirror-symmetry studies compare transformer, oriented mid-level, and classical descriptors against human or task-specific similarity judgments. Results show that feature scale and architecture matter, while tuned hand-crafted representations can approach deep models at much lower cost.

topics.name: Computational Neuroimaging
topics.summary: Neuroimaging infrastructure and multiscale EEG analyses organize heterogeneous brain data for behavioral and dimensional studies. The work emphasizes interoperable processing, feature design, and cautious interpretation when signals are weak or protocols differ.

topics.name: Computational Political Science with Language Models
topics.summary: Political-language studies use coalition simulations, ideological audits of encyclopedic content, and hierarchical stance datasets from short-video conversations. Provenance, multi-judge comparison, and human annotations help separate model-generated narratives from measurable political patterns.

topics.name: Computational Social and Urban Dynamics
topics.summary: Computational studies model how social structure and institutions evolve across science networks, legislatures, community rumor processes, and urban neighborhoods. Historical measurement, community-aware diffusion, and behavioral indicators connect algorithmic analysis to real collective dynamics.

topics.name: Computational biology, chemistry, and causal modeling
topics.summary: These papers study causal, physical, and statistical modeling in biology and chemistry using mediation, materials, protein, and cell-related data; analyses find that structured priors improve sample efficiency while making identifiability assumptions visible.

topics.name: Computational pathology
topics.summary: Pathology systems use spatial transcriptomics, pathway cues, tissue anchors, and region retrieval to connect whole-slide morphology with gene estimates, biomarkers, and prognosis. Sparse molecular evidence is treated as guidance for visual reasoning rather than a disconnected feature block.
