topics.summary: Two data-management studies extend dependency discovery with efficient order handling and probabilistic functional-dependency support. Their algorithms make schema-level structure usable when observations are incomplete or uncertainty should be reported rather than hidden.

topics.name: Differentiable Vector Graphics
topics.summary: Differentiable graphics systems represent layouts as executable programs or continuous curve fields and optimize element-level structure. Their evaluations address pixel accuracy, editability, and the gap between semantic similarity and geometric fidelity.

topics.name: Diffusion-image watermarking
topics.summary: These methods pair approximate diffusion inversion with spatially synchronized message designs to preserve watermark recovery after geometric edits. Evaluations balance verification speed, reconstruction quality, and robustness to cropping, rotation, scaling, and unseen distortions.

topics.name: Domain-specific image segmentation
topics.summary: Benchmark studies compare lightweight transfer-learned encoders for satellite land-cover mapping and expert-decoding strategies for fine-grained food imagery. Their findings emphasize resource efficiency, category imbalance, overlap handling, and realistic evaluation datasets.

topics.name: Facility placement and resource allocation
topics.summary: Placement problems optimize locations, assignments, or layouts under geometric and resource constraints, comparing exact, heuristic, and learned search strategies.

topics.name: Feature selection and representation diagnostics
topics.summary: Feature-selection studies diagnose spurious correlations and learn compact representations, using perturbation, attribution, and stability tests to connect features with generalization.

topics.name: Frequency-aware image restoration
topics.summary: Wavelet-guided diffusion reconstruction for electron microscopy and compact blind color denoising separate structure from detail; frequency-aware processing improves fidelity across noise levels without requiring large restoration models.

topics.name: Gait analysis and locomotion modeling
topics.summary: Gait studies model locomotion from wearable or video signals, using temporal dynamics and subject-aware features to distinguish patterns across people and conditions.

topics.name: GenAI Platforms and Content Economics
topics.summary: Platform studies model attribution competition and advertising sidecars around generated answers. Their analyses show that revenue mechanisms, disclosure, and credit assignment can improve monetization while creating tradeoffs in welfare, visibility, and incentives for upstream model providers.

topics.name: Graphics rendering and visual computing
topics.summary: Rendering systems address ray-traced ambient effects and passive timing signals for resistant CAPTCHA design. The work combines low-level visual computation with hardware-observable behavior and efficiency or security considerations.

topics.name: Haptic Teleoperation and Feedback Control
topics.summary: These papers connect haptic teleoperation and feedback control with stiffness, device, and honeycomb; their abstracts examine jamming and mechanism under measurable data or deployment constraints.

topics.name: Human-centered educational technologies
topics.summary: Interactive learning systems study adaptive peer assistance in collaborative programming and accessible exploration of complex charts. Skill-sensitive hints and tactile or spoken representations support more productive help and stronger spatial understanding for blind and low-vision learners.

topics.name: Identifiability and closure in dynamical models
topics.summary: Dynamical-systems theory studies when latent state, randomness, or behavior can be identified from observations, clarifying limits of closure and predictive world models.

topics.name: Image segmentation
topics.summary: Segmentation methods combine weak labels, foundation features, and spatial priors to delineate anatomy or objects, with cross-domain robustness as a recurring test.

topics.name: Indoor visual localization and operational navigation
topics.summary: The systems combine multi-hypothesis localization, floorplan geometry, clearance constraints, and instrument-specific approach regions for indoor tasks. Their emphasis is on reaching a usable pose in repetitive environments rather than merely identifying an object or map coordinate.

topics.name: Instance-aware layout generation
topics.summary: Instance-aware generation separates neighboring objects in layout-conditioned synthesis, using explicit instance assignments to improve boundaries and controllability.

topics.name: Interpretable machine-learning representations
topics.summary: The papers make representations inspectable through local linear explanations, distortion analysis, and representative prototype selection. Their evaluations span tabular, text, image, and temporal data, showing how compact evidence can clarify nonlinear models without explaining every feature.

topics.name: LLM-Simulated Human Behavior
topics.summary: Psychometric evaluations compare prompted synthetic respondents with human surveys across domains and item difficulties. Cognitive-profile prompts can improve aggregate calibration, but demographic prompting may exaggerate group differences, making real-response validation essential before operational use.

topics.name: LLM-assisted scientific literature organization
topics.summary: These systems apply retrieval, eligibility screening, topic assignment, and explainable text classification to scientific corpora. Survey and biomedical indexing results show that language models can accelerate organization when their labels and evidence remain inspectable.

topics.name: Language, cognition, and social behavior
topics.summary: Psycholinguistic modeling, semantic memory, diachronic compositionality, theory of mind, behavioral biases, and aphasia simulation.

topics.name: Language-Guided Decision Making
topics.summary: Language models act as selective advisors inside partially observed or changing control problems. Persistent state, uncertainty gates, and replanning policies determine when textual assistance is useful while leaving low-level execution to conventional decision mechanisms.

topics.name: Large Language Models for Neuroscience and Memory Research
topics.summary: Language models are used both as structured hypothesis generators and as comparison systems for memory representation, retrieval, updating, and intervention. Connectome-informed literature synthesis produces testable circuit ideas, while brain-model comparisons emphasize functional parallels rather than anatomical identity.

topics.name: Lens and camera-aware vision
topics.summary: Camera-aware vision work models lens, optics, and calibration effects, using geometric constraints to improve reconstruction and robustness under changing capture conditions.

topics.name: Load balancing for multimodal experts
topics.summary: Expert-load methods balance heterogeneous token streams in multimodal mixture-of-experts models, reducing routing imbalance caused by image resolution and prompt length.

topics.name: Model merging and vocabulary adaptation
topics.summary: Model-merging work combines task or language capabilities while preserving tokenizer compatibility, measuring interference, transfer, and parameter efficiency after adaptation.

topics.name: Morphology-aware tokenization
topics.summary: Tokenizer optimization aligns vocabulary construction with greedy decoding and the morphology of classical Indian languages. Integer-program objectives, native-script data, and held-out fertility measurements reduce segmentation overhead and improve contextual efficiency.

topics.name: Neural sharpness and generalization
topics.summary: Closed-form Hessian-based updates and joint sharpness-complexity analyses examine why flatter solutions can generalize better. The work links spectral structure, optimization geometry, and empirical performance across neural-network settings.

topics.name: Neuromorphic and Acoustic Sensing
topics.summary: The group develops efficient event-driven or spiking systems for sound localization, fall detection, speech commands, gunshot recognition, BCI decoding, and embedded multimodal perception.

topics.name: On-device learning and embedded AI
topics.summary: Device-oriented learning brings training or inference to constrained hardware, combining personalization, energy-aware scheduling, and compact representations for embedded workloads.

topics.name: Online fair division of indivisible goods
topics.summary: Online allocation studies characterize when irrevocable assignments can preserve fairness and efficiency under budgets, valuation growth, density assumptions, and prediction error. EF1, Pareto optimality, resource augmentation, and learning-augmented guarantees define the feasible frontier.

topics.name: Pixel-level generative modeling
topics.summary: Pixel-level generation papers control local appearance and spatial structure with diffusion or flow-based models, evaluating edits, textures, and high-resolution synthesis.

topics.name: Policy learning under large or long-run constraints
topics.summary: Structured sampling, importance weighting, actor-critic estimation, and neural primal-dual updates address enormous action spaces and persistent constraints. The analyses balance exploration, statistical error, policy improvement, and constraint violation rather than optimizing reward alone.

topics.name: Program repair and structured input correction
topics.summary: Repair systems transform malformed code or structured inputs into valid outputs, using syntax-aware decoding, constrained generation, and execution-based verification.

topics.name: Reasoning traces and inference-time refinement
topics.summary: Inference-time reasoning methods use self-consistency, rollouts, and external checks to improve difficult answers, while measuring cost and the reliability of intermediate traces.

topics.name: Reservoir computing and recurrent dynamics
topics.summary: Reservoir-computing studies analyze recurrent dynamics and memory capacity, using fixed or sparsely trained reservoirs for nonlinear temporal prediction and stability tests.

topics.name: Robust small-object insect vision
topics.summary: Mesh-free Gaussian perturbations and field-video detection address small pollinators under clutter, blur, occlusion, and scale imbalance; diverse appearance simulation and high-resolution features improve robustness more consistently than elaborate post-processing.

topics.name: SPAD sensing and photon-efficient imaging
topics.summary: SPAD imaging work reconstructs depth or intensity from photon-counting measurements, pairing probabilistic sensing models with neural refinement under low-light conditions.

topics.name: Sampling structured probability distributions
topics.summary: Influence-based Boolean-product sampling and mirror-Langevin discretizations replace generic distributional assumptions with geometric conditions; the analyses provide convergence or finite-sample guarantees for structured non-Euclidean targets.

topics.name: Semantic communication for robotics and edge AI
topics.summary: Task-conditioned image coding, semantic beamforming, and robot-edge testbeds transmit compact visual meaning instead of raw sensor streams. Mapping and object interaction remain useful when bandwidth and compute are constrained, provided the retained semantics match the task.

topics.name: Signal processing and sensing
topics.summary: These papers connect signal processing and sensing with framework, network, and local; their abstracts examine spaces and attention under measurable data or deployment constraints.

topics.name: Simulation and monitoring for surgical robotics
topics.summary: These systems support autonomous suturing with GPU-parallel contact simulation and action-conditioned deviation monitoring. The combination enables reinforcement-learning data generation and calibrated failure alarms even when successful demonstrations are more available than labeled failures.

topics.name: Sleep Physiology and Clinical Time Series
topics.summary: Large polysomnography cohorts and single-channel staging models use temporal fusion, cohort discovery, and longitudinal signals to connect sleep measurements with disease and clinical phenotype. The methods prioritize scalable analysis while retaining local and global rhythm information.

topics.name: Social science and AI governance
topics.summary: These papers connect social science and ai governance with polarization, cooperation, and ideological; their abstracts examine peer and welfare under measurable data or deployment constraints.

topics.name: Spanish language modeling and cultural NLP
topics.summary: Spanish-language research adapts language models and speech or text pipelines to regional variation, examining data scarcity, morphology, and culturally specific evaluation.

topics.name: Speech recognition and synthesis
topics.summary: Speech systems learn recognition, synthesis, and expressive control from audio-text pairs, evaluating multilingual transfer, speaker characteristics, and perceptual quality.

topics.name: Structured Clustering and Missing-Data Imputation
topics.summary: Latent subgroup discovery, alternating cluster refinement, historical retrieval, and generative completion preserve heterogeneity when observations are incomplete or unlabeled. The methods target more faithful structure recovery than local interpolation or fixed-class assumptions.

topics.name: Synthetic data for imbalanced learning
topics.summary: Across tabular, clinical, and image benchmarks, synthetic examples are used to reduce skew and test robustness. Quantum sampling, watermarking, rare-disease record generation, and label-controlled augmentation are assessed through utility, fidelity, and annotation-efficiency measures.

topics.name: Table Understanding and Semantic Annotation
topics.summary: Table systems improve question answering and schema interpretation through distilled ranking traces, symbolic decision materialization, and explicit column semantics. The shared emphasis is on making multi-table retrieval and labels both more accurate and easier to inspect.

topics.name: Theoretical analysis of language-model behavior
topics.summary: Formal results bound hallucination tolerance and characterize how sequence dynamics distinguish language models. Error thresholds, dynamical separation, and sequence length yield limits on generative power and discrimination capability.

topics.name: Topological and Geometric Learning
topics.summary: These papers connect topological and geometric learning with topology, variables, and euler; their abstracts examine graphs and belief under measurable data or deployment constraints.

topics.name: Urban Language and Cross-City Analysis
topics.summary: These papers connect urban language and cross-city analysis with city, profiles, and validation; their abstracts examine aggregate and through under measurable data or deployment constraints.

topics.name: Visual biometric recognition
topics.summary: Vehicle and cow recognition benchmarks vary pose, occlusion, identity similarity, and capture conditions; pretrained visual backbones and realistic protocols expose generalization gaps hidden by curated human-focused datasets.

topics.name: 3D geometry and articulated human representations
topics.summary: Geometric studies learn minimal surfaces, anthropometric heads, sketch and portrait meshes, dynamic hair, and articulated pose representations. Explicit geometry and temporal routing make human or object shape estimates more stable and controllable than appearance-only prediction.

topics.name: 3D registration, reconstruction, and semantic mapping
topics.summary: Synthetic pretraining, semantic data association, and leakage-controlled validation reduce the cost of patient-specific registration and photogrammetric reconstruction. Related systems jointly estimate poses, landmarks, object meaning, and reconstruction reliability from geometric observations.

topics.name: AI Evaluation and Measurement
topics.summary: Adaptive challenges, deployment replays, simulator checks, human-calibrated scoring, factor selection, and agreement analysis expose how evaluation design changes conclusions about capability and safety. Reference quality and latent measurement assumptions are recurring sources of error.

topics.name: AI-assisted electronic design and software repair
topics.summary: Language models, graph-based CAD representations, defect prediction, test prioritization, repair agents, and cross-model code review support engineering workflows. Reliable systems combine generated artifacts with connectivity checks, iterative tests, and deterministic validation.

topics.name: Aerial robotics and navigation
topics.summary: UAV systems address pose, metric depth, formation control, GNSS-denied search, viewpoint planning, tether-aware exploration, wind estimation, and runtime edge orchestration. Their evaluations emphasize energy, obstacle safety, uncertainty, and operation in partially observed environments.

topics.name: Agent Safety, Provenance, and Verification
topics.summary: Memory attribution, belief revision, provenance tracking, transactional tool use, information-flow controls, evidence graphs, and external outcome checks constrain agent actions. These methods reduce stale-memory errors, unsafe repairs, prompt-driven exfiltration, and unsupported claims.

topics.name: Annotation, morphology, and mobility analysis
topics.summary: Annotation and recognition systems use morphology, seasonal priors, mobility or pose structure, and linguistic form to handle sparse or variable labels. The applications span astronomy, wildlife, ancient languages, and human activity, where domain knowledge improves transfer and interpretation.

topics.name: Auditable AI Evaluation and Benchmark Validity
topics.summary: Benchmarking work combines data profiling, uncertainty estimates, reference-free checks, provenance tests, and post-task verification. Across language, agent, and clinical settings, scores become more useful when evaluation scope, evidence quality, leakage risk, and transfer assumptions are made explicit.

topics.name: Behavioral health and mental-health language modeling
topics.summary: Social-media and conversational data are modeled with emotional, temporal, interpersonal, and circadian signals to study substance use, depression, disclosure, and support seeking. Results provide population-level associations but caution against treating linguistic separation as individual diagnosis.

topics.name: Benchmarking, rubrics, and relational analysis
topics.summary: Benchmark design and evaluation methods study rubric dependence, relational structure, correlation, and decision validity in model-generated answers. The work favors dependency-aware scoring, targeted criteria, and analyses that reveal when aggregate agreement hides redundancy or systematic failure.

topics.name: Biomedical sensing, neurotechnology, and biosignal decoding
topics.summary: Wearable, optical, EEG, fMRI, prosthetic, neural, and physiological sensing with efficient representation and decoding methods.

topics.name: Biometric anti-spoofing and foundation vision
topics.summary: Audio and face authenticity systems combine pretrained encoders with reconstruction, regional evidence, and task-specific decoders. Across changing capture conditions and limited-label eye or face datasets, selective adaptation matters more than relying on a frozen foundation representation alone.

topics.name: Calibration-light human sensing and handwriting reconstruction
topics.summary: The methods infer human activity or pen motion from Wi-Fi, ultrasound, inertial, and hover-contact signals with limited per-user calibration. Cross-rate alignment, zero-shot semantic transfer, temporal models, and writer adaptation improve reconstruction under hardware and demographic variation.

topics.name: Clinical foundation models and radiological data
topics.summary: Multimodal EHR pretraining, radiological data harmonization, and latent analysis of weakly supervised mammography examine fusion, metadata, labels, and representation degradation; standardized inputs and mechanistic diagnostics clarify when extra modalities help.

topics.name: Clinical normalization and biomechanical sensing
topics.summary: These studies reconcile measurements across records, sensors, and physical tasks. Clinical medication conventions, robot dynamics, gait force estimation, and contact behavior show that timing, reference frames, and sensor placement can materially change inferred outcomes.

topics.name: Computational imaging and learned compression
topics.summary: Optical multiplexing and differentiable reconstruction recover measurements from ill-conditioned observations, while learned compression discovers reusable transforms and adaptive filters. Across imaging and coding, physical structure is paired with compact learned inference to control complexity and distortion.

topics.name: Computational linguistics and literary studies
topics.summary: Morphological production, discourse prosody, hidden-state structure, literary transformation, and World Englishes are analyzed with benchmarks, speech measurements, and representation probing. The recurring concern is how models encode linguistic variation, narrative form, and prestige norms beyond surface fluency.

topics.name: Continual learning
topics.summary: Replay selection, performative retraining, and quantum continual-learning analyses ask how updates preserve useful signals while the data or feedback process changes. Forward transfer and model-independent convergence improve when memory or regularization reflects task relationships.

topics.name: Coordinates, world models, and scene descriptions
topics.summary: World-model research links spatial coordinates, learned descriptions, agent environments, and narrative reconstruction. The methods use geometric state, persistent scenes, and structured descriptions to support planning, simulation, or interactive experiences beyond static image generation.

topics.name: Data-driven optimization and engineering design
topics.summary: Surrogate experiments, inverse integer optimization, learned solver iterates, optimal stopping, UAV sizing, power-flow planning, and transformation sensitivity use explicit constraints or finite-complexity analysis; data-efficient search improves tractability when evaluations are costly or structured.

topics.name: Datasets and human-centered AI studies
topics.summary: Dataset and user-facing studies create resources for gait identity, counseling, laboratory-robot failures, driving style, media credibility, social LLM behavior, photo archives, and conference history. Their empirical value comes from realistic interaction traces, ethical release choices, and domain-specific annotation rather than scale alone.

topics.name: Decision-making and cognitive engineering
topics.summary: Formal decision models and engineering assistants address military simulation, moral reasoning, engine prediction, and explainable cognitive architectures. The studies combine structured states, domain rules, and learned estimates to make complex decisions more inspectable and operationally useful.

topics.name: Deepfake and expression analysis
topics.summary: Forgery detection and human-expression modeling use multimodal embeddings, demographic cues, facial dynamics, open-set recognition, and cellular-scale representations. The studies emphasize generalization beyond known artifacts, identity preservation, and the distinction between visual realism and trustworthy provenance.

topics.name: Diffusion sampling theory
topics.summary: Finite-sample analyses of score learning and conditional particle methods separate optimization, approximation, discretization, initialization, kernel, and Monte Carlo effects. These guarantees clarify which components dominate error when diffusion and sequential sampling methods are implemented at practical scales.

topics.name: Digital Humans and Identity-Preserving Face Synthesis
topics.summary: Audio-visual human generation and diffusion-based face synthesis compress expressive motion or identity evidence into manageable conditioning. Results emphasize synchronized speech, temporal continuity, parent-identity balance, and the realism-identity tradeoff relevant to biometric applications.

topics.name: Digital twins for industrial maintenance
topics.summary: Across industrial maintenance studies, digital-twin architectures, remaining-life value estimates, evidence-grounded agents, and physically checkable fault features recur; distributed monitoring becomes more useful when diagnosis and explanations remain auditable.

topics.name: Distributional Learning and Optimal Transport
topics.summary: Kernel discrepancy bounds, distribution embeddings, Sinkhorn dynamics, generative coupling, and adversarial transport study how probability measures can be compared or constrained. Results connect contraction, lower bounds, and sample-based transport to robustness and computational efficiency.

topics.name: Diverse Representations and Query Localization
topics.summary: These papers connect diverse representations and query localization with diversity, representation, and issue; their abstracts examine ambiguity and analogy under measurable data or deployment constraints.

topics.name: Education, tutoring, and learning assessment
topics.summary: Adaptive tutoring, learner simulation, essay and drawing assessment, educational measurement, and generative AI adoption in higher education.

topics.name: Ensemble learning and generalization
topics.summary: The studies connect ensemble diversity, margin behavior, stability, feature perturbations, and architecture selection to generalization. Theory and experiments suggest that complementary members can matter as much as individual accuracy when building robust predictors.

topics.name: Evaluation, ranking, and citation analysis
topics.summary: Assessment methods study automated scoring, search ranking, citation or indicator quality, and research-agent evidence. They compare human and model judgments, inspect criterion-level reliability, and seek measures that reflect coverage, usefulness, and factual support rather than stylistic fluency.

topics.name: Evolutionary optimization and automated design
topics.summary: Evolutionary optimization papers search over programs, architectures, or policies with mutation, population selection, and learned surrogates, comparing solution quality and search efficiency.

topics.name: Extremal combinatorics and differential posets
topics.summary: Extremal set constructions, arithmetic-progression intersection bounds, and computational investigation sharpen finite cases and challenge conjectured rank inequalities. Structural proofs are combined with exhaustive or human-AI-assisted search over combinatorial families.

topics.name: Failure analysis for AI systems
topics.summary: Failure-analysis studies reproduce serving, planning, and deployment breakdowns, then trace them to workload coverage, feedback loops, or hidden coupling between system components.

topics.name: Feature selection and model selection
topics.summary: These papers connect feature selection and model selection with sieve, coverage, and loss; their abstracts examine plv and training under measurable data or deployment constraints.

topics.name: Feature-Based Prediction and Detection
topics.summary: These papers connect feature-based prediction and detection with framework, only, and features; their abstracts examine however and spectral under measurable data or deployment constraints.

topics.name: Flexible Job-Shop Planning and Aggregation
topics.summary: These papers connect flexible job-shop planning and aggregation with plan, fjsp, and textbf; their abstracts examine sadq and correction under measurable data or deployment constraints.

topics.name: Formal schemas, provenance, and process mining
topics.summary: Event-log forecasting, scientific protocols, communication models, and agent workflows become more reproducible when entities, steps, constraints, and lineage are explicit. Structured representations support consistency checks, refinement synthesis, and clearer separation between data quality and model behavior.

topics.name: Formal specification and verified reasoning
topics.summary: Execution-grounded specification benchmarks, Lean formalization, FastLAS instruction, quantum-field claim repair, executable contracts, and metamorphic spatial tests connect language outputs to checkable semantics. The studies show that running or mechanically validating generated artifacts is stronger than judging plausibility by text alone.

topics.name: Generative Diagnostic Reporting
topics.summary: These papers connect generative diagnostic reporting with generation, report, and anomaly; their abstracts examine corepath and cnb under measurable data or deployment constraints.

topics.name: Geometric assembly and physics-informed modeling
topics.summary: Physical structure guides learning for interlocking assemblies, inverse scattering, electromagnetic behavior, and geometry-aware generation. The methods use constraints, recursive construction, energy or equation-based priors, and material structure to improve extrapolation beyond purely data-driven fits.

topics.name: Governance and Assurance of Autonomous AI
topics.summary: These works measure autonomy, inspect agent evidence, and frame deployment through accountability, cyber resilience, data-quality gates, provenance, and operational stealth. The recurring finding is that reliable oversight must cover runtime behavior and institutional consequences together.

topics.name: Graph and hypergraph learning
topics.summary: Graph methods study noisy hypergraphs, tropical or relational representations, surgical temporal relations, and topology-aware optimization, reporting more stable structure learning and interpretable coordination.

topics.name: Hardware, photonics, and neuromorphic computing
topics.summary: Photonic security, optical co-design, neural acceleration, binary networks, mixed precision, quantum hardware, and neuromorphic control.

topics.name: Human Evaluation of AI-Assisted Knowledge Work
topics.summary: Human studies compare AI and expert outputs in scientific planning, literature support, coding artifacts, preprint impact, and chess analysis. They find that speed and apparent quality depend on task and evaluator, with systematic preference effects and domain-specific verification needs.

topics.name: Human-Centered AI and Conversational Effects
topics.summary: Accessibility tools, therapist-facing reminiscence support, extended-reality interfaces, muscle stimulation, and conversational-agent studies adapt systems to cognitive or emotional needs. User evaluations emphasize agency, reduced setup burden, participation, and risks of dependency or vulnerability amplification.

topics.name: Human-centered and affective AI interaction
topics.summary: User studies and interactive agents examine trust, perceived minds, affective dialogue, ethical reflection, and technology visions from justice-impacted communities. Timing, personalization, stakeholder participation, and deliberate friction shape autonomy and responsibility more reliably than persuasive explanations alone.

topics.name: Identifiability in latent-variable and inverse models
topics.summary: Latent-state identification, symmetry breaking, and city-scale source apportionment study when hidden structure can be recovered from indirect observations. The analyses provide recovery conditions, minimax limits, and diagnostics for ambiguity in statistical and physical inverse problems.

topics.name: Image generation and scene editing
topics.summary: Image-generation studies add spatial or instance-level control to diffusion systems, using layouts, masks, and scene context to place or edit objects consistently.

topics.name: LLM behavior, prompt robustness and human interaction
topics.summary: Prompt wording, answer order, expectations, repeated-game commitments, tutoring style, and group interaction all affect how people interpret or use language models. Controlled comparisons reveal gaps between apparent cooperation, confidence, pedagogical quality, and stable task competence.

topics.name: Language Agents for Financial Markets
topics.summary: Financial-agent studies combine market signals, discourse, risk controls, and mandate-aware re-grounding in simulated asset environments. Periodic profile checks can stabilize behavior, but performance and adherence vary with market regime and agent disposition.

topics.name: Language Use and Cognitive Modeling
topics.summary: Language studies measure contextual persistence, code-switched entrainment, language-area evidence, synthetic poetry, radio corpora, turn-taking, and convergence between model and human cognition. The recurring theme is that sequence behavior reflects both reusable linguistic structure and interaction-specific adaptation.

topics.name: Language-model alignment and instruction following
topics.summary: Alignment work studies instruction following, preference optimization, and refusal behavior using curated comparisons, reward signals, and adversarial prompts to separate helpfulness from unsafe compliance.

topics.name: Learning Dexterous Manipulation from Human Videos
topics.summary: These methods convert human demonstrations or unconstrained videos into robot-ready motion, grounding hand-object interaction, embodiment transfer, active perception, and reusable dexterous skills.

topics.name: LiDAR/Radar Localization and SLAM
topics.summary: The group addresses cross-view place recognition, non-repetitive scanning, underwater event SLAM, quadruped sensing, GNSS-aided odometry, visual-inertial consistency, and large-scale semantic geolocation.

topics.name: ML systems and hardware
topics.summary: These papers connect ml systems and hardware with training, existing, and reranker; their abstracts examine moe and inference under measurable data or deployment constraints.

topics.name: Mathematical foundations and scientific learning
topics.summary: Theory papers develop formal tools for optimization, graph learning, variational systems, and scientific computation. Proofs and controlled numerical studies identify regimes where assumptions, regularization, or geometry determine stability.

topics.name: Mechanism design and strategic AI agents
topics.summary: Audit policies, reputation penalties, complaint mechanisms, and online signaling schemes steer agents when private information or truthful confidence cannot be assumed. The analyses provide behavioral, welfare, or regret guarantees under strategic interaction.

topics.name: Mechanistic Interpretability of Model Representations
topics.summary: Probing, relocation, geometric measurement, and causal intervention examine how transformer hidden states store facts, types, instructions, concepts, and refusal behavior. Findings distinguish representation presence from usable recall or correction, and show that attention alone is an unreliable explanation of model behavior.

topics.name: Multimodal affect, language, and sign communication
topics.summary: Affective computing, hesitancy, sign-language recognition and translation, speech perception, and multimodal behavioral analysis.

topics.name: Multimodal representation alignment and adaptation
topics.summary: These papers compare shared representations, parameter injection, and modality-specific routing across language and vision. Their results show uneven transfer between modalities, favoring selective adaptation and reliability-aware fusion over uniform integration.

topics.name: Multimodal representation and explanation diagnostics
topics.summary: Vision-language evaluations examine logical distinctions, caption quality, negation recovery, biomedical feature interactions, and concept-specific interpretability failures. The methods combine structured attribution, frozen-feature probing, and reconstruction-based tests to expose what multimodal models encode or miss.

topics.name: Multiview and graph information fusion
topics.summary: Graph-embedded multiview learning, density-based fusion, and embedded hyperspectral processing combine complementary sources under structural and deployment constraints. The methods address unreliable residual information, heterogeneous representations, and efficient inference on constrained hardware.

topics.name: Networked computing infrastructure
topics.summary: Networked systems co-design communication paths and computation placement, spanning CUDA remoting, diffusion-inference overlap, and 6G architectures. The work focuses on latency, throughput, synchronization, and scalable coordination across heterogeneous links and accelerators.

topics.name: Neural memory theory
topics.summary: Theoretical analyses quantify storage, expressivity, and interference in transcript machines and associative neural networks. High-entropy representations and layered memories clarify how capacity can coexist with generalization and resistance to later updates.

topics.name: Online Content Moderation and Counterspeech
topics.summary: Moderation research evaluates filter placement, response rewriting, misinformation exposure, user history, and contextual counterspeech through platform data and user studies. Interventions gain utility when they preserve benign intent and audience context, although stronger filtering can reduce coverage.

topics.name: Operational agentic AI
topics.summary: Self-calibrating edge allocation, enterprise operational case studies, and intrinsic-reward grounded search combine forecasting, evidence retrieval, and cost-aware action selection; reliable agents need bounded behavior and feedback that reflects changing resource or task conditions.

topics.name: Physics-guided computational imaging
topics.summary: Differentiable ray and wave-optics models, synthetic diffusion images, and physics-based MRI optimization address calibration, reconstruction, and landmark detection. X-ray, CT, and EPI experiments show gains when measurement geometry and data consistency are included in learning.

topics.name: Portfolio and decision optimization
topics.summary: Portfolio, assortment, pairwise-comparison, trade, and medicine-allocation studies incorporate cardinality, ambiguity, reference values, and scarce-data constraints. Evolutionary search, distributionally robust optimization, neural predicates, and decision-aware training connect mathematical objectives to operational allocation choices.

topics.name: Quantized and low-precision inference
topics.summary: Low-precision methods compress weights, activations, or representations with quantization-aware optimization, measuring accuracy, memory use, and throughput across language and vision models.

topics.name: Recurrent attention and long-context modeling
topics.summary: Recurrent state, retention mechanisms, hierarchical indexing, context distillation, and cross-layer memory reduce the cost of extended sequences. Results examine what information survives compression, how retrieval changes with iteration, and when compact state can replace full attention.

topics.name: Reflective editing and system repair
topics.summary: Visual editing, model repair, hardware debugging, and interactive agent improvement rely on localized diagnosis followed by constrained changes. Across images, repositories, neural modules, and conversational systems, the studies separate useful intervention from cosmetic modification and measure preservation of valid behavior.

topics.name: Research workflows and empirical methodology
topics.summary: Research-method papers examine reproducibility, system integration, and human evaluation, using audits, interaction logs, or controlled comparisons to identify hidden sources of variance.

topics.name: SAR and rotation-equivariant 3D perception
topics.summary: SAR diffusion models and point-cloud registration methods use structural priors, spherical harmonics, equivariant features, and scale-aware pretraining. Experiments target controllable radar synthesis, rotation-robust correspondence, and transferable representations for geometric sensing.

topics.name: Safety assurance for autonomous and AI systems
topics.summary: Autonomous systems pair learned policies with formal shields, runtime fallbacks, adaptive fault handling, external authorization, attestations, and fail-closed logs. Spacecraft guidance and broader high-impact agent execution illustrate how independent checks can contain unsafe actions during adaptation.

topics.name: Schema-Constrained NLP and Data Workflows
topics.summary: Schema validation, quality rules, relational consistency checks, structured simulation intermediates, clinical response repair, and spatial metadata views turn ambiguous language or heterogeneous data into inspectable outputs. topics.name: Clinical imaging and biomedical health
topics.summary: Clinical imaging work spans surgical manipulation, medical landmark localization, MRI translation, anomaly diagnosis, and esports screening, using learned priors and uncertainty checks to support reliable decisions.

topics.name: Computer vision recognition
topics.summary: These papers connect computer vision recognition with detection, classification, and ood; their abstracts examine evaluation and feature under measurable data or deployment constraints.

topics.name: Geospatial, climate and environmental forecasting
topics.summary: Spatial graphs, coordinates, remote sensing, biomass references, station guidance, attribution tools, diffusion refinement, and new atmospheric observations improve forecasts of mobility, forests, pollution, clouds, temperature, and precipitation. Evaluation emphasizes fine-scale structure, extremes, transfer, and interpretability.

topics.name: Language resources and text analysis across cultures
topics.summary: Language-focused resources cover Buddhist and historical corpora, coreference disagreement, literary translation, abstractive summarization, narrative transformation, and Mandarin tone analysis. The papers connect dataset design and linguistic structure with more reliable analysis across genres, eras, and languages.

topics.name: Optimization Theory and Neural Training Dynamics
topics.summary: Optimization analyses study adaptive step control, Muon geometry, local-SGD heterogeneity, Hamiltonian sampling, fractional gradients, residual-network stability, and hyperconnection design. Their experiments and bounds distinguish lower training loss or faster computation from improvements that transfer to new data.

topics.name: Optimization and learning systems
topics.summary: Learning-system studies connect cognitive decision models, scientific anomaly search, invariant-learning objectives, adaptive world-model execution, and active inference through formal or empirically checked optimization principles.

topics.name: Planning, scheduling, and program synthesis
topics.summary: Planning studies use execution feedback, constraint solvers, reinforcement learning, and search to improve text-to-SQL, scheduling, code, and embodied decision making.

topics.name: Robot Safety and Policy Assurance
topics.summary: Robot safety studies combine active policy testing, acceleration-based and belief-space barrier constraints, formal policy synthesis, and representation-level risk probes. Simulated and physical evaluations show that explicit violation controls are needed when learned behavior faces perturbations, crowds, or hazardous actions.

topics.name: Robot navigation and embodied agents
topics.summary: Embodied navigation combines affordance grounding, outdoor accessibility, future-map imagination, visual-inertial estimation, and predictive driving dynamics, testing transfer from controlled scenes to physical environments.

topics.name: Social Computing and AI Governance
topics.summary: Rulemaking audits, legal-scope analysis, newsroom adoption, national policy comparison, digital accessibility, data trust, online stigma, influence campaigns, and institutional coordination examine AI in social settings. Mixed-method evidence shows that participation, authority, and organizational context shape outcomes beyond model capability.

topics.name: Statistical learning and decision theory
topics.summary: Theoretical papers cover semiparametric tangent spaces, PAC learnability, degradation-trajectory bounds, bandit complexity, graph inner products, weight decay, and quantized Fourier coefficients. They use counterexamples, sharp sample limits, and asymptotic analysis to identify where intuitive generalization claims fail.

topics.name: Statistical learning theory and uncertainty
topics.summary: Theory and statistical-method papers develop learning guarantees, conformal or probabilistic uncertainty, bandit and regression analyses, and optimization results, connecting finite-sample behavior to reliable decisions.

topics.name: Time series and dynamical systems
topics.summary: These papers connect time series and dynamical systems with under, language, and action; their abstracts examine trajectory and training under measurable data or deployment constraints.

topics.name: Visual perception and 3D reconstruction
topics.summary: Perception and reconstruction methods build view-consistent 3D scenes, implicit SLAM maps, dense face geometry, wireless localization fields, and cross-view descriptors from incomplete visual evidence.
